purpose: Teach: あいかわらず/おまかせ/さがし/わかれ/しるし/さながら/すごし/段々

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、あいかわらずスマホ見すぎだろ
lines.en: Riku, you're glued to that phone as always, aren't you?
lines.style: Teasing, familiar lilt on 'as always.' Quick rhythm. Affectionate edge underneath the jab. Like she's caught him red-handed and finds it funny.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お昼はおまかせの定食頼めよ、桜
lines.en: You should try the chef's choice set lunch instead, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting with suggestion. Light, easy tone — not defensive but redirecting. Casual, like he's offering genuine advice while dodging her point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のノート、教室でさがしてやったぞ
lines.en: Hey — I found your notebook in the classroom. Thought you'd want it back.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery with a small note of pride. No big deal on the surface, but there's care underneath. Straightforward, like she's done him a solid and isn't fishing for thanks.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、卒業でわかれる時、泣くんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're gonna cry when we all split up after graduation, aren't you?
lines.style: Testing, curious. Softer than her usual tone. Watching his face. Like she's asking something she actually wants to know the answer to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テストの答えにしるし付けてんな
lines.en: I saw you marking up the test answer key. Careful, that's not what you're supposed to be doing.
lines.style: Caught-you-again tone. Knowing smirk underneath the words. Not scolding, just calling out. Warm exasperation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテスト点、さながら奇跡だな、桜
lines.en: Your test scores are practically miraculous these days, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine praise wrapped in light mockery. Slower on the praise, quicker on the joke. Warm but keeping his distance. Like he means it but won't let her see how much.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、週末ゆっくりすごしてんだろ?
lines.en: So you're taking it easy on the weekends now?
lines.style: Curious, checking in. Casual delivery but there's an undertone of — I'm paying attention to what you do. Light, easy question that signals she sees him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、勉強、段々できるようになってきたな、桜
lines.en: Your studying's actually getting better little by little, Sakura.
lines.style: Sincere compliment underneath cool exterior. Slower pace, genuine weight on the words. Eye contact level steady. Letting her know he's noticed, without making a show of it.
